{{Quote|Those people, Agent Loor, conspired with the Emperor's murderers. They have learned that their actions have consequences, and they regret their past disloyalty. In their previous arrogance they dared believe the Empire was superfluous and could be replaced. Now they know this is not true. All that is good in their lives comes from the Empire. They have been shown the truth and now live for a chance to be allowed back into our brotherhood.|Ysanne Isard|<ref name="rogue">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>}}
'''Toprawa''' was a remote, [[Forest/Legends|forested]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Toprawa system/Legends|Toprawa system]] of the [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]] in the [[Bright Jewel Oversector/Legends|Bright Jewel Oversector]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].

==History==
[[File:AnshariiCaverns.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Ansharii Caverns/Legends|Ansharii Caverns]] during the Great Sith War]]
During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], Toprawa was the site of a [[Battle of Toprawa (Great Sith War)|battle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]] led by [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]].<ref name="SW:KOTOR33:Vp2" />

At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], an experiment went terribly wrong and destroyed an entire laboratory complex situated on Toprawa.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Caught in the Act}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.

Toprawa was also known for its community of [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] Antarian Ranger [[Aren Folee]] was based on world,<ref name="TLJ" /> and it was also the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Antarian Ranger turned [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer]].<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Toprawa was the site of a secret [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] outpost for transferring information from their network of [[Spy/Legends|spies]] to the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]].

It was on this planet that the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] was developed, the plans for which were subsequently stolen by [[Havet Storm]] and the Rebel Alliance. There were also [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] about the Station's hull design, and [[Life support/Legends|life support]] infrastructure.<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> Among many others [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bria Tharen]] and Rebel cell leader [[Vermilion (Rebel Alliance)|Vermilion]] gave their lives during the [[Battle of Toprawa]] to secure the plans for [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. The Rebel group used the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled [[Toprawa Relay Station]] to transmit the plans to the [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] aboard the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']].

The planet was then punished by the Galactic Empire: Cities were destroyed, and entire planetary regions thrust into poverty.<ref name="TEA" /> Many among its population were made to prostrate themselves to the Empire for aid. By [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], it still had not been captured by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Toprawa in the Dufilvan sector (a misspelling of the true [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian sector]]). It is correctly located in the [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]], according to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.
